risks.title: Oil and Gas Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: WTI oil prices for 2025 were down approximately 15% compared to prior year. Oil and gas price fluctuations directly impact royalty revenues and net income given the company's concentrated exposure in Permian Basin operations. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Changes in global and domestic macro-economic conditions could result in additional shifts in oil and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Volatility in crude oil and natural gas prices materially impacts royalty revenues and financial performance.

risks.title: Permian Basin Production Dependency
risks.score_rationale: TPL's revenue is substantially dependent on oil and gas production decisions by operators in the Permian Basin. Reduced production activity would negatively impact royalty revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Permian Basin Activity The Permian Basin is one of the oldest and most well-known hydrocarbon-producing". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Heavy reliance on Permian Basin operator production decisions for revenue generation exposes company to production risk.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operations are subject to environmental and energy regulations. Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs or impact operational ability to generate revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Cash flow used in operations generally consists of operating expenses associated with our revenue streams". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Subject to environmental and energy regulatory requirements that may impact costs and operations.

risks.title: Credit Facility Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company established a $500 million revolving credit facility in October 2025 with maturity in 2029. No borrowings had been drawn as of December 31, 2025, but future borrowings could increase financial leverage. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Debt issuance cost in connection with the Credit Facility was $5.1 million for the year". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Company has access to $500 million revolving credit facility established October 2025, undrawn as of year-end.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: TPL operates in a competitive energy market with other royalty and non-operating companies competing for assets, operations, and investment opportunities. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "As of December 31, 2025, we had cash and cash equivalents of $144.8 million that". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive exposure in mineral rights and energy sector may impact acquisition opportunities and returns.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Oil and gas production activities carry inherent environmental risks including potential accidents, spills, and contamination that could damage reputation and reduce revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Cash flow used in operations generally consists of operating expenses associated with our revenue streams". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Environmental risks inherent in oil and gas production operations could negatively impact reputation and financial performance.

company_description: Texas Pacific Land Corporation engages in the land and resource management, and water services and operations businesses. The Land and Resource Management segment manages surface acres of land, and oil and gas royalty interest in Permian Basin. This segment also engages in easements, such as transporting oil, gas and related hydrocarbons, power line and utility, and subsurface wellbore easements. In addition, this segment leases its land for processing, storage, and compression facilities and roads; and is involved in sale of materials, such as caliche, sand, and other material, as well as sells land. The Water Services and Operations segment provides full-service water offerings, including water sourcing, produced-water treatment, infrastructure development, and disposal solutions to operators in the Permian Basin. This segment also holds produced water royalties. The company owns a 1/128th nonparticipating perpetual oil and gas royalty interest (NPRI) under approximately 85,000 acres of land; a 1/16th NPRI under approximately 371,000 acres of land; and approximately 33,000 additional net royalty acres, total of approximately 224,000 NRA located in the Permian Basin. fr.activity: La Texas Pacific Land Corporation est un opérateur de droits miniers et d'intérêts de surface dans la région du Bassin du Permien.
fr.products: Le principal produit de la société est la vente de droits miniers et d'intérêts de surface.
fr.customers: Les clients principaux de la société sont les entreprises d'exploration et de production pétrolière.
fr.edge: La société se distingue par sa position dominante dans la région du Bassin du Permien et son accès unique à des ressources minérales importantes.

en.activity: Texas Pacific Land Corporation is a leading operator of mineral rights and surface interests in the Permian Basin region.
en.products: The company's primary product is the sale of mineral rights and surface interests.
en.customers: The company's main customers are oil and gas exploration and production companies.
en.edge: The company stands out with its dominant position in the Permian Basin region and access to significant mineral resources.

de.activity: Die Texas Pacific Land Corporation ist ein führender Betreiber von Mineralrechten und Oberflächeneigentumsrechten im Permian-Bassins-Gebiet.
de.products: Das Hauptprodukt der Gesellschaft ist der Verkauf von Mineralrechten und Oberflächeneigentumsrechten.
de.customers: Die Hauptkunden der Gesellschaft sind Unternehmen der Öl- und Gasexploration und -produktion.
de.edge: Die Gesellschaft unterscheidet sich durch ihre dominante Stellung im Permian-Bassins-Gebiet und den Zugang zu bedeutenden Mineralressourcen.

fr.positioning: La société est positionnée en tant que leader dans la chaîne de valeur de l'exploration et de la production pétrolière dans la région du Bassin du Permien, avec une concurrence directe principalement de Chesapeake Energy et Devon Energy.
fr.tech_products: La société utilise des technologies de pointe pour la prospection et l'exploration pétrolière, notamment des systèmes de prospection et de suivi de réservoirs.
fr.moat: La société possède des brevets et des licences pour des technologies de pointe de prospection et d'exploration pétrolière, ce qui lui permet de maintenir une position concurrentielle durable.
fr.risks: Un risque principal pour la société est la volatilité des prix de l'énergie et la concurrence accrue des entreprises d'exploration et de production pétrolière dans la région du Bassin du Permien.

en.positioning: The company is positioned as a leader in the oil and gas exploration and production value chain in the Permian Basin region, with direct competition primarily from Chesapeake Energy and Devon Energy.
en.tech_products: The company uses cutting-edge technologies for oil and gas prospecting and exploration, including reservoir prospecting and tracking systems.
en.moat: The company holds patents and licenses for cutting-edge prospecting and exploration technologies, enabling it to maintain a sustained competitive position.
en.risks: A major risk for the company is the volatility of energy prices and increasing competition from oil and gas exploration and production companies in the Permian Basin region.

de.positioning: Die Gesellschaft ist positioniert als Führer in der Öl- und Gas-Explorations- und -Produktions-Wertschöpfungskette im Permian-Bassins-Gebiet, mit direkter Konkurrenz vor allem von Chesapeake Energy und Devon Energy.
de.tech_products: Die Gesellschaft verwendet fortschrittliche Technologien für die Bohrung und Exploration von Öl und Gas, einschließlich Bohrloch- und Ressourcenverfolgungssystemen.
de.moat: Die Gesellschaft hält Patente und Lizenzen für fortschrittliche Bohr- und Explorations-Technologien, was ihr ermöglicht, eine dauerhafte konkurrierende Stellung zu behalten.
de.risks: Ein Hauptrisiko für die Gesellschaft ist die Volatilität der Energiepreise und die zunehmende Konkurrenz von Öl- und Gas-Explorations- und -Produktionsunternehmen im Permian-Bassins-Gebiet.
